page_evidence: Header 'Daun Hester', 'Sign Up As A Supporter', 'Voting Locations' with Norfolk precincts (TITUSTOWN, Titustown Rec Center, 7545 Diven St.); footer 'Copyright 2010 Daun Sessoms Hester'.
note: Lead: a 2010-02-13 blog post says Hester kicked off her campaign for Mayor of Norfolk and links daunhester.com. CDX shows 19 HTTP 200 captures from 2010-01-15 to 2010-02-17 (all before the 2010-05-04 election, none after 2010-02-17 in window). The archived pages read (home, action, events, learn, links, location, media, speech, photo) name the candidate and carry supporter signup, volunteer and polling place content, but none of the text I read contains the word 'mayor'. I accept on the 'vote' criterion plus the dated news post; this is a doubt for review. daunhester.org is a later 2012-2014 site (House of Delegates) and has no capture in window, so it is not accepted.
